chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
You are to me in the position of Aaron to Moses (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the comparison between Ali and Aaron in this hadith?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith, known as the Hadith of Manzilah, is central to Shia theology as it establishes Ali ibn Abi Talib's unique status as the Prophet's successor and spiritual heir, mirroring Aaron's role as Moses' deputy. While the verse in Surah Ta-Ha (20:29-35) originally referred to Aaron, Shia scholars argue that the Prophet's declaration extends this prophetic lineage and authority to Ali, confirming his position as the first Imam after the Prophet. This connection underscores the continuity of divine guidance and leadership within the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-263 According to the same documentation, it has been narrated that Ali (a.s.) said that the Prophet (S) told him, “
Your position relative to me is like that of Aaron’s position relative to Moses (a.s.).”
